campaigns.title: Active Staking Rewards (ASR) Apr - Jun 2026
campaigns.description: ASR incentivizes active JUP participation with increased voting power.
campaigns.ctaDescription:
#### What's in ASR Pool?

For this ASR Period (Apr - Jun 2026)
* 50M JUP will be distributed to stakers during this period.
* ASR is calculated using a time-weighted average of your stake during this period.
* An average of 50 JUP or more staked during this quarter is eligible for ASR.

#### ASR Recap & Explainer

* [ASR (Active Staking Rewards) Notes](https://discuss.jup.ag/t/asr-active-staking-rewards-notes/12032)
* [What is ASR & Why it Matters](https://youtu.be/o-yj5j-2ig8)
* [Meow: Juply & ASR](https://youtu.be/joywhnFpFfM)

ctaFaqs.text:
Jupiter's community of cadets, voters, and users is huge and diverse. ASR functions as a bootstrapping mechanism to incentivize Jupiter's community to be involved in decisions, voting, and discussions.

It is an innovative reward system that rewards voters based on voting activity and community participation.
ctaFaqs.title: What is ASR?

ctaFaqs.text:
ASR Pool consists of JUP from excess unclaimed JUP from the 1st Jupuary airdrop, you can refer to [this proposal](https://discuss.jup.ag/t/asr-active-staking-rewards-notes/12032) for more information.

During inception of ASR, it was utilizing JUP from JUP's usage of the LFG Launchpad, but has since renewed. In addition, 0.75% LFG Launchpad fee of other launches were distributed as well and for this period, there is no LFG Launchpad fee.
ctaFaqs.title: How is the ASR Pool determined?

ctaFaqs.text:
ASR is distributed per quarter.

For this quarter's ASR, it is calculated based on your daily time-weighted average stake of JUP. An average of 50 JUP or more staked is eligible for ASR.
ctaFaqs.title: How is my allocation calculated?

ctaFaqs.text:
If you have an ongoing unstake, you will need to wait for it to complete or cancel the unstake before claiming your JUP rewards.

All JUP will be automatically added to your stake account after claiming. These stake accounts are viewable on vote.jup.ag.
ctaFaqs.title: Why can't I claim my JUP?

campaigns.title: Dominion Silver
campaigns.description: Trade $SILV over 2 weeks for a share of $25,000 JupUSD. Each week has its own leaderboard, and every eligible trade also counts toward the Overall leaderboard.
campaigns.ctaDescription:
#### Campaign format

Dominion Silver runs for 2 weeks, with a fresh leaderboard and $10,000 JupUSD reward pool each week. Round 1 runs from 13 August 2026 at 2:00 PM UTC to 20 August 2026 at 2:00 PM UTC. Round 2 runs from 20 August 2026 at 2:00 PM UTC to 27 August 2026 at 2:00 PM UTC.

The Overall leaderboard tracks weighted volume across both weeks and has a separate $5,000 JupUSD reward pool.

#### Scoring

Points are weighted USD volume: eligible Dominion Silver trading volume multiplied by the applicable route multiplier. Metis volume receives a 1x multiplier, Ultra volume receives a 2x multiplier, and Limit Order and DCA volume receive a 3x multiplier.

The top 50 wallets on each leaderboard qualify. Each qualifying wallet receives a pro-rata share of that leaderboard's reward pool based on its share of weighted volume.

ctaFaqs.text:
Dominion is sponsoring a total prize pool of $25,000 JupUSD:

- Round 1: $10,000 JupUSD
- Round 2: $10,000 JupUSD
- Overall: $5,000 JupUSD

Each reward pool is calculated and distributed independently. All rewards are sponsored by [Dominion](https://dominion.market/).
ctaFaqs.title: What are the prizes?

ctaFaqs.text:
Dominion Silver runs for 2 weeks across 2 consecutive 1-week rounds. Each round has its own leaderboard and $10,000 JupUSD reward pool, and rankings start fresh at the beginning of each round.

- Round 1: 13 August 2026 at 2:00 PM UTC to 20 August 2026 at 2:00 PM UTC
- Round 2: 20 August 2026 at 2:00 PM UTC to 27 August 2026 at 2:00 PM UTC

The Round 1 and Round 2 tabs show these scoring periods. Other campaigns may use different round durations.
ctaFaqs.title: How do the rounds work?

ctaFaqs.text:
The Overall leaderboard tracks weighted volume across the full 2-week campaign. It does not reset between rounds and has a separate $5,000 JupUSD reward pool.

A wallet can qualify for rewards from either round, the Overall leaderboard, or all 3 leaderboards.
ctaFaqs.title: What is the Overall leaderboard?

ctaFaqs.text:
Points are exactly weighted USD volume: eligible Dominion Silver trading volume multiplied by the applicable route multiplier. Wallets are ranked by points, and the top 50 wallets on each leaderboard qualify for that leaderboard's reward pool.

Rewards are distributed pro rata. Rank determines whether a wallet qualifies, while its share of weighted volume determines its share of the reward pool. Amounts displayed while the campaign is running are estimates until scoring is finalized.
ctaFaqs.title: How are rankings and rewards calculated?

ctaFaqs.text:
Eligible volume executed through Metis receives a 1x multiplier. Eligible volume executed through Ultra receives a 2x multiplier. Eligible volume executed through Limit Order or DCA receives a 3x multiplier.

Multipliers affect leaderboard points, not the amount traded or received in the underlying transaction.
ctaFaqs.title: How do volume multipliers work?

ctaFaqs.text:
Eligible Dominion Silver trading volume executed through Jupiter Metis, Ultra, Limit Order, or DCA during the applicable round counts toward that round's leaderboard and the Overall leaderboard.

Trades outside a leaderboard's displayed scoring period do not count toward that leaderboard.
ctaFaqs.title: Which trades count?

ctaFaqs.text:
Use Jupiter Wallet Extension or Jupiter Mobile to claim during the claim window shown on the campaign page. Unclaimed rewards expire when the claim window closes.

Leaderboard results and rewards may take time to finalize after the campaign ends.
ctaFaqs.title: How can I claim rewards?

ctaFaqs.text:

[Dominion](https://dominion.market/) is the Promoter and reward sponsor for this Campaign.

**Promoter's discretion**

Dominion may amend, suspend, void, or cancel the Campaign, in whole or in part, at any time, including where required by applicable law or where the integrity of the Campaign is compromised.

**Finality of decisions**

Dominion's decisions on all matters relating to the Campaign, including qualifying volume, multiplier application, points, leaderboard rankings, reward calculations, and Participant eligibility, are final and binding.

**Leaderboard and reward calculations**

Leaderboard positions and estimated rewards shown during the Campaign are provisional and may be delayed, incomplete, or adjusted during final review. Final rewards are based on validated backend records after scoring is finalized. Displayed amounts may be rounded.

Each round reward pool and the Overall reward pool are calculated independently. Qualification for one leaderboard does not guarantee qualification for another.

**Prize substitution and withholding**

Dominion may substitute or withhold any reward, in whole or in part, where delivery is unduly difficult or impossible, where applicable law prevents receipt, where a Participant fails to provide required recipient information in time, where the Participant breaches these Terms, or where an impediment arises beyond Dominion's reasonable control.

**Claiming and expiry**

Eligible Participants must use Jupiter Wallet Extension or Jupiter Mobile to claim during the claim window shown on the Campaign page. Rewards that are not claimed before the claim window closes expire and may no longer be available.

**Limitation of liability**

Dominion is not liable for inaccuracies or delays in provisional leaderboard displays, or for any loss, cost, or damage incurred by a Participant in connection with the Campaign. Nothing in these Terms excludes liability that cannot be excluded under applicable law.

campaigns.description: Build a 5-pick challenge from 72 World Cup markets on Jupiter Predict. Get all 5 right to win a share of the prize pool — $100,000 for paid entries, plus a $25,000 pool everyone can enter for free.
campaigns.ctaDescription:
#### Winners

* **$100,000 Paid Pool — 899 winning slips, ~$111.23 per slip.**
* **$25,000 Free Pool — 37,207 winning slips, ~$0.67 per slip.**

#### How to play

* Choose 5 of the 72 available World Cup markets on Jupiter Predict.
* You can only select markets priced at 70% or less implied odds (filtered in-app) — so you can't simply stack near-certain favorites.
* Correctly predict all 5 selections to qualify for a share of the prize pool.
* $100,000 Prize Pool — $10 per entry, unlimited entries.
* $25,000 Prize Pool — free first entry for everyone (a 0.0005 SOL anti-spam transfer is required); every $10 entry also grants 1 additional entry into this pool.
* All entries that go 5/5 share their prize pool.

ctaFaqs.text:
There are two prize pools, and within each pool every entry that correctly predicts all 5 selections shares it equally:

* $100,000 Prize Pool — for paid entries.
* $25,000 Prize Pool — open to everyone, with a free first entry.
ctaFaqs.title: What can I win?

ctaFaqs.text: Each entry is a combination of 5 markets selected from the 72 available World Cup markets. You can only select markets priced at 70% or less implied odds — this is filtered in-app, so heavy favorites can't simply be stacked to guarantee a win. At 70% odds per pick, getting all 5 right is roughly a 1-in-6 outcome. An entry only qualifies if all 5 selections resolve correctly — if a user gets 4 right but misses the 5th, they won't get the winnings for the 4 matches.
ctaFaqs.title: How does it work?

ctaFaqs.text:

* Paid entry — $10 each into the $100,000 pool, with unlimited entries per wallet.

Every $10 entry also grants you one additional entry into the $25,000 pool.

campaigns.description: ASR incentivizes active JUP participation with increased voting power.
campaigns.ctaDescription:
#### What's in ASR Pool?

For this ASR Period (Oct - Dec 2025)
* 50M JUP will be distributed to stakers during this period.
* ASR is calculated using a time-weighted average of your stake during this period.
* An average of 50 JUP or more staked during this quarter is eligible for ASR.

#### ASR Recap & Explainer

* [ASR (Active Staking Rewards) Notes](https://discuss.jup.ag/t/asr-active-staking-rewards-notes/12032)
* [What is ASR & Why it Matters](https://youtu.be/o-yj5j-2ig8)
* [Meow: Juply & ASR](https://youtu.be/joywhnFpFfM)

ctaFaqs.text:
Jupiter's community of cadets, voters, and users is huge and diverse. ASR functions as a bootstrapping mechanism to incentivize Jupiter's community to be involved in decisions, voting, and discussions.

It is an innovative reward system that rewards voters based on voting activity and community participation.
ctaFaqs.title: What is ASR?

ctaFaqs.text:
ASR Pool consists of JUP from excess unclaimed JUP from the 1st Jupuary airdrop, you can refer to [this proposal](https://discuss.jup.ag/t/asr-active-staking-rewards-notes/12032) for more information.

During inception of ASR, it was utilizing JUP from JUP's usage of the LFG Launchpad, but has since renewed. In addition, 0.75% LFG Launchpad fee of other launches were distributed as well and for this period, there is no LFG Launchpad fee.
ctaFaqs.title: How is the ASR Pool determined?

ctaFaqs.text:
ASR is distributed per quarter.

For this quarter's ASR, it is calculated based on your daily time-weighted average stake of JUP. An average of 50 JUP or more staked is eligible for ASR.
ctaFaqs.title: How is my allocation calculated?

ctaFaqs.text:
If you have an ongoing unstake, you will need to wait for it to complete or cancel the unstake before claiming your JUP rewards.

All JUP will be automatically added to your stake account after claiming. These stake accounts are viewable on vote.jup.ag.
